messages.text: Washer W-17 stops after rinse. Bulletin SB-4 mentions a latch check.
વોશિંગ મશીન રિન્સ પછી બંધ થાય છે. SB-4 જુઓ.
Machine rinse પછી stop થાય છે; latch error E17 દેખાય છે.

Proposal only. Technician note one says latch intermittent. Technician note two repeats the symptom. The customer signature and quoted history repeat older details. Current safety bulletin SB-9 says stop and escalate when insulation damage is visible.
